stage: Three sample concepts for visual review; existing live game assets have not been replaced.

samples.label: Kapak batu
samples.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one isolated inventory item sprite for Tidewake: Island Survival, a polished 2D top-down retro pixel-art survival RPG set on tropical islands with shipwrecks, exploration, crafting and restrained fantasy. The CURRENT game has crisp pixel characters and terrain, deep plum inventory slots (#120f22), purple panels (#1d1a33), golden brass accents (#e8b04b), ivory text (#f4ecd8), and saturated but harmonious ocean blues and forest greens.
Style/medium: beautifully hand-pixelled SNES-era RPG inventory sprite, upgraded clarity and thoughtful material shading. Construct the item on a consistent logical 32x32 pixel grid, then enlarge the same grid to a square high-resolution output using nearest-neighbor so individual equal-sized square pixels are clearly visible. Genuine pixel art with chunky, clean pixel clusters and a 1 logical pixel deep-plum outline. No smooth contours or subpixel painting. Approximately 16 to 24 colors, three or four discrete shading values per material, light consistently from upper left, cool shadows on lower right. Prioritize an immediately recognizable silhouette at actual small inventory scale.
Composition/framing: exactly ONE complete item centered in a square canvas, occupy about 75 to 82 percent of the canvas, modest even transparent margins, no cropping. The remaining canvas must be genuinely transparent, including the corners. No scenery, background color, baked checkerboard, card, frame, pedestal, text, letters, watermark, labels, UI or other items. No realistic rendering, gradients, blurred edge, glow haze, floating decorations or cast ground shadow. This is a usable cutout icon, not an illustrated concept sheet.
Subject: ONE primitive STONE AXE, the game's existing item axe_stone. A sturdy driftwood handle tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right, subtly tapered, two or three readable honey-brown wood bands, a broad asymmetrical knapped slate stone axe head in the upper-right portion with an obvious cutting edge on its left side, firmly attached with a neat pale flax rope binding. The head is unmistakably stone, NOT polished metal: cool blue-grey facets, a couple of controlled chipped-edge notches, dark slate underside and a small pale blue highlight. Warm ochre and chestnut wood, cream rope, slate blue-grey stone, dark plum contours. Survival craftsmanship, practical and attractive, no ornament or magical elements. Keep enough thickness in the handle and blade to read at 32 pixels.

Subject: ONE HEALING POTION BOTTLE, the game's existing item healing_potion. A squat round glass flask with short straight neck and warm tan cork stopper, seen mostly front-on with a slight top view. Translucent seafoam-blue glass represented by hard pale-cyan pixel clusters and a single crisp upper-left glint; the lower two-thirds contain rich coral-red healing liquid with a readable horizontal surface. Give the bottle a simple satisfying rounded silhouette constructed of pixel steps, a few cream highlights, ruby-red lower-right shading and a narrow flax collar at the neck. No hanging charm, no printed label, no letters, no external sparkles. Ocean-island herbal alchemy feel, elegant simplicity, clearly red healing consumable, compact and legible at 32 pixels.

Subject: ONE OLD SAILOR'S COMPASS, the game's existing quest item compass used to navigate home from a shipwrecked island. A closed circular pocket compass viewed face-on from a mild overhead angle, with a small robust suspension loop above the case. Substantial weathered golden-brass rim with warm amber bevel on the right and pale cream upper-left highlights; the face is pale sand parchment, featuring a clean four-point dark teal compass rose and ONE red north needle with ivory opposite half. Crisp centered pivot, only a few large readable cardinal ticks, absolutely no lettering. A thin dark inset ring separates the face from the rim. Brass-gold, warm sand ivory, deep ocean teal and a red needle with plum outlines; antique nautical survivor's keepsake, refined and legible, no lid, no chain, no map, no other objects. Round contour formed solely by clean square pixel steps.
